newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Oil delays start-up of 100,000 bpd topper.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Oil delays start-up of 100,000 bpd topper.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday it will delay the start-up of a 100,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit at its Mizushima plant to October 9, five days later than originally scheduled.

The unit, which has been closed since early September for routine checks, could not resume operations as scheduled because maintenance work was often interrupted by rainy weather, a Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said.
The other topper at the 250,000 bpd refinery in Okayama prefecture, western Japan, is not expected to be shut for maintenance this year.
